_comment: Minimal in-repo terminology allowlist for the SEEDED TerminologyService stub (data-is-not-code). Covers exactly the RxNorm / LOINC / SNOMED-CT / ICD-10-CM codes the demo pipeline fixtures use, plus a few ICD-10 diagnoses with a stub CMS-HCC mapping so classify() has demo data. NOT a real terminology server; production uses a FHIR terminology server ($validate-code / $translate / ValueSet $expand).

conceptMap._comment: Minimal $translate stub pairs, keyed sourceSystem->targetSystem then source code.

membership._comment: Wave A (I8A-ii) versioned value-set membership. The CURRENT-version members of each governed system are the keys of codeSystems[system].codes (single source of truth, DRY). This block adds ONLY the version deltas: retiredInCurrent = codes removed as of the current bound version (valid in a prior version, invalid now), and priorVersions = how an older version's membership differs from current (adds/removes), so $expand can enumerate a specific version and a retired code is provable. Codes here are ILLUSTRATIVE STUBS, not the full authority release.

ucum._comment: Wave A (I8A-ii) UCUM unit validation for LOINC quantitative results. validUnits is an illustrative allowlist of well-formed UCUM unit atoms (a real server parses the UCUM grammar); loincUnits maps a quantitative LOINC to the units appropriate for it. A LOINC absent from loincUnits is treated as non-quantitative (no unit check). NOT the full UCUM registry.
